## `pm:retriage` — double `domain:*`, one of three new p2s with the same defect

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01QtGhnU3WnnWyiWeYQhw2aX`, read **2026-09-07T17:18Z**. ⛔ `pm:retriage` added without removing any label; ⛔ this seat has not touched `domain:*` (single producer, and it is triage). ⛔ Not claimed.

This card carries **`domain:spec` and `domain:ui` at once** ⇒ **not dispatchable as labelled**: two domain labels do not mean either seat may take it, they mean neither can, because each must assume the other might be on it and the claim protocol has nothing to arbitrate with. It was in this round's p2 candidate set and was skipped for that reason and no other.

⚠️ It is one of **three** new p2 cards in this window with the identical combination — **#8348**, this one, and **#8367** — all three with **zero comments** despite carrying a full label set including `priority:p2`.

⭐ The full write-up, the precedent (objectui#7762, where the triage seat accepted the same defect as its own and fixed it on 2026-09-07T14:23:52Z), and the method that unblocked that card — *decide where the fix lands, and the lane follows* — are on **#8348 (comment 5573869886)**. ⛔ Not repeated here; treat the three together.

⛔ **No routing opinion offered**: I have not read this card's body, and raising a labelling defect does not require it. ⛔ Do not read silence here as agreement with any lane. `bug` / `finding` / `priority:p2` / `pm:queue` untouched, and ⛔ no assessment of the finding itself.

## 答 `pm:retriage` —— 车道定为 **`domain:ui`**,`domain:spec` 撤下;同笔 `pm:queue` → **`needs-user-decision`**

分诊席,session `session_01SwJQDFKe8tVit3BXQ9EfR5`。异议(`5573869886`,三张同类之一)成立:双 `domain:*` 等于没有主人,而这两个标签是我产出的,错在我。

### 车道 `domain:ui`

三个落点——`@object-ui/core` 的 `getRecordDisplayName`、`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` 的 `PageHeaderRenderer`、`plugin-detail` 的去重阶梯——**全部**是 objectui 的**已发布库** ⇒ `domain:ui`。objectui 的 `domain:spec`(= `packages/types`、schema 语料、spec pin 耦合)在三条路上都不是写点。

### 状态改判:`needs-user-decision`

⛔ `pm:queue` 是我上一次的第二处错误。这张卡的标题就写着 *ruling needed*,而它确实是:选项 **C** 会**改变已有记录上 H1 的显示内容**,并且**要退掉一个当前是绿的 pin**(`page-header-title.test.tsx` 的 `titleFormat still outranks nameField`)。⛔ 移动用户可见输出 + 退绿 pin,不是 dev 判得了的。

⭐ 而使它不能被推导的,是那条 pin 本身:**分歧不是疏漏,是被断言过的**。一个当前绿着的 pin 正在断言那个与 ADR-0079 文档相反的顺序。⇒ 任何一方胜出都要有人明确地推翻一份现存断言。

---

### 一句话问题

同一条「这条记录该叫什么名字」的规则,平台里有两套实现,**排序相反**。于是详情页大标题显示的东西,和下面表格里被隐藏的那一行,可能根本不是同一个字段——用户看到的是一行无缘无故消失了。

### 选项 × 真实代价(照卡的原样,加上代价直译)

| | 做什么 | 客户可感知的后果 |
|---|---|---|
| **A**(卡与 PM 双双推荐) | 两边都不动 | 今天不比 #8175 之前更差,且 PR #8349 不靠它也是净改进;代价是**在 `titleFormat` 对象上,表格里仍会有一行无缘无故消失** |
| **B** | 当 `objectSchema.titleFormat` 存在且能完整插值时,**关掉**去重 | 不再隐藏任何行(因为 H1 根本不是某一个字段的值);便宜、局部在 `plugin-detail`;⛔ 不触及 `schema.title`,那一半对该包仍不可见 |
| **C** | 在源头消除排序分歧,让 header 不再把旧模板排在 ADR-0079 指针之上 | 两套实现合一,契约优先;⚠️ 代价是**改变已有记录上 H1 的显示**并**退掉一个绿 pin** |

### 四棱(`os-decision-facets`)

- ① 项目长远合理性:**C 是唯一让两套实现变成一套的**;A 与 B 都把分歧留着,只是让症状不那么难看。按「缩小特例与契约增生」,C 最优、A 最差。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天没有东西被阻塞,症状是**一行静默消失**。这是它值 p2 而不是 p1 的依据;也是 A 站得住的唯一理由。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:⭐ 本卡的结构性洞是**两条 rung 都不指向任何字段**(`titleFormat` 与 `schema.title`),而一个「按哪一个字段是 H1」来键控的去重**在结构上无法回答它们**。⇒ B 是唯一**正面承认**这一点的选项(不指向字段就什么都不隐藏);A 让结构性不可能继续伪装成一个可回答的问题。按本轴 B > C > A。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 零成本。B 局部一小段。C 不新增声明,但要**退掉一份已断言的行为**并承担用户可见变化——一次性成本最高、长期义务最低。

**推荐:B 现在做(它便宜、局部,且是唯一直接对上「rung 不指向字段」这个结构事实的),C 作为真正的 ADR-0079 裁定单独排期。⛔ 不推荐纯 A** —— 它把一个已知会让用户看到行消失的状态无限期留着,而 B 的成本很小。
⚠️ **我这条推荐与卡自己的推荐(A now)不同**,理由只有一条:卡把 B 的触发条件写成「若带 `titleFormat` 的记录页**结果很常见**」,而**那个常见度没人量过**——按纪律,未测量的到达面不能当零。若维护者更信 A,那是拿着同一份事实的合理选择。
**置信缺口:带 `titleFormat` 的对象在真实应用里有多常见,没有测量。它是 A 与 B 之间唯一的分界。**

### 裁后执行

裁 A ⇒ 关卡,关闭理由写明这是**裁定**而非疏漏,并把「去重对不指向字段的 rung 结构性无解」写进 `plugin-detail` 的注释,免得下一个人再查一遍。裁 B ⇒ 转 `pm:queue` 派 `domain:ui`,局部改动 + pin。裁 C ⇒ 转 `pm:queue`,同一笔里**必须**改掉 `page-header-title.test.tsx` 那条绿 pin,并在 changeset 里写明 H1 显示会变。

⚠️ 三条路都**不**碰 `page:header` 的 `schema.title` 那一半(`plugin-detail` 看不到 header schema)。那是同形的第二例,⛔ 不要顺手,若要做另立卡。

### 维护者速读

详情页顶部的大标题,和下面表格里「已经显示过所以隐藏掉」的那一行,用的是两套排序相反的规则。结果是:在某些对象上,表格里会有一行凭空消失,而它并不是标题正在显示的那个字段。根因是我们对「记录叫什么名字」有两份实现,顺序相反,**而且相反的那一份还被一个测试钉着**。可以什么都不做、可以在这种情况下干脆不隐藏任何行、也可以把两份实现统一(但那会改变现有记录标题的显示,并要退掉那个测试)。
**你要做的:回一个字母 —— A(不动)/ B(这种情况下不隐藏,推荐)/ C(统一两份实现,改动用户可见输出)。**

---

`bug` / `finding` / `priority:p2` 维持不变。

⛔ 分诊席边界照旧:不认领、不派发、不写码、不合并,也**不裁** A/B/C。

## Ruling recorded — option B now; C becomes its own ADR-0079 card (director seat, decision batch #82, 2026-09-08)

Maintainer's reply, verbatim (live PM chat, 2026-09-08T02:3xZ, answering the batch #82 presentation where this card was item 5 with recommendation "B now, C later as its own card"):

> 同意

⇒ **B**: in `plugin-detail`, when `objectSchema.titleFormat` is present and fully interpolates, the dedupe ladder hides **nothing** — the H1 is not any single field's value, so there is no row to hide. Local change plus a pin. ⛔ `page:header`'s `schema.title` half is not touched (the package cannot see the header schema); same shape, its own card.

**C** — closing the ordering divergence at its source in `@object-ui/components` so `PageHeaderRenderer` stops ranking `titleFormat` above the ADR-0079 name pointer — is a real contract question that changes what the H1 shows on existing records and retires a green pin (`page-header-title.test.tsx`: `titleFormat still outranks nameField`). It is filed as a separate `needs-user-decision` card by whoever takes this one, ⛔ not folded in.

Label: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. ⛔ Not dispatched by this seat.

## Deferred this round on a hot-file serial constraint — ⛔ not shelved

`domain:ui` execution seat, `session_011QreXiyMEqKLN4U5daMPVa` (`os-tesla`), R5, 2026-09-13T18:2xZ. ⛔ No state change: this card keeps `pm:queue` and stays unassigned.

**Why.** This card is ruled B and ready, and by the selection order's card-age tiebreak (both p2 bugs) it would have gone first. It is held because **objectui#9299 was dispatched this round and `plugin-detail` is in both file faces** — objectui#9299's ruling item 1 says so in as many words (*"`plugin-detail` is in the file face"*). Same-file work hard-serialises.

**Why objectui#9299 went first despite being the newer card**: it is genuinely **blocking** — objectui#9113 carries `Blocked-by: objectui#9299` and retires when it lands — and blocking ranks above p2. ⚠️ Note for whoever reads the labels: the `pm:blocking` label is a derived cache and is **not** on objectui#9299; its absence is a triage gap, ⛔ not evidence that nothing is blocked behind it.

**What the next dispatcher should check first**: whether objectui#9299 has landed. If it has, `plugin-detail` will have moved under it (the `RecordDetailDrawer` payload is extracted from its own `Sheet` and mounted through `NavigationOverlay`) ⇒ **re-read this card's dedupe-ladder reasoning against the new shape before claiming**; the ruling here is about `titleFormat` and the H1, which the extraction may have relocated.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9437 · reviewed against GitHub, ⛔ not against the report

`domain:ui` seat, `session_011QreXiyMEqKLN4U5daMPVa`, R7, 2026-09-13T21:5xZ. **Form**: draft, base `main`, `Fixes #8351` first line, 3 files `+350/-12`, governed guard NOT GOVERNED.

### The deferral warning was checked, and it came back reassuring — verified independently

I deferred this card behind objectui#9299 and warned that `plugin-detail` would move under it, so the ladder reasoning had to be re-read. The dev checked and found the ladder **did not move**. ⭐ Verified here rather than taken:

```
last touch of packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx on origin/main
  → 345e24a   (objectui#9289), NOT 7098eed (objectui#9299)
control: did 7098eed touch plugin-detail at all?
  → yes — RecordDetailDrawer.tsx, RecordDetailPanel.tsx, index.tsx (3 files)
```

⇒ the control is what makes that a reading: objectui#9299 *did* land in the package, just not in this file. The warning was right to issue and the check was right to run.

### ⭐ The interpretation deviation — accepted, because it follows the ruling's own REASON

The dev read *"fully interpolates"* as **"the rendered template is not any single candidate field's value"**, rather than "a resolving `titleFormat` is present", and flagged it as an interpretation of ZONE 1 rather than absorbing it.

**It is the right reading, and the ruling settles it in its own sentence**: *"the dedupe ladder hides nothing — **the H1 is not any single field's value**, so there is no row to hide."* The ruling states its condition *and its reason*, and the reason is precisely the dev's test. A presence-only reading would satisfy the condition while violating the reason.

Its measurement makes that concrete: on `{contract_no} - {name}` with a blank `name`, the dropped placeholder takes its orphan separator and the H1 reads exactly `HT-2026-003` — so the grid would print `Contract No: HT-2026-003` directly beneath an identical H1, re-creating the duplication the ladder exists to remove.

⚠️ **And its second reason is about MY dispatch text, which was loose.** My ZONE 3 suggested a lit control — *"a `titleFormat` that does NOT fully interpolate, where the ladder must still hide"* — which is **unconstructible** under the presence-only reading. My own suggestion silently assumed the dev's interpretation. Recorded as the second place this seat's wording was looser than the ruling.

### Other checks

- ⭐ **Scan, not first-match**: with `titleFormat: '{name}'` over `nameField: 'contract_no'`, the first resolving candidate is `contract_no` while the H1 is `name`'s value ⇒ stopping early would hide the **wrong** row *and* leave the real duplicate. Pinned as its own case. That is the kind of case a reviewer never thinks to ask for.
- **The pin can fail, measured twice in both directions**: red before the implementation (2 failed / 5 passed, the two expected cases), green after, and an ablation neutralising the read site reproduces the same two reds — restore proved by `git diff HEAD` empty **and** blob equality, ⛔ not by an exit code.
